name: digup
title: DigUp Launcher
description: Search files by name and by what's inside them, locally on your Mac.
author: stavan

commands.name: search-files
commands.title: Search Files with DigUp
commands.description: Find files and folders by name, or describe an image, document, recording, or code.

commands.name: setup
commands.title: Open DigUp Settings
commands.description: Open DigUp to choose folders and manage indexing.

preferences.name: indexDirectory
preferences.title: Content Index Folder
preferences.description: Leave empty to use DigUp's configured index. Set only for a custom index.

preferences.name: nameScope
preferences.title: File Name Search Folder
preferences.description: Spotlight searches this folder and its subfolders. Defaults to your home folder.

preferences.name: searchMode
preferences.title: Default Search Mode
preferences.description: Combine content search with file and folder names, or use only one.

preferences.name: rememberRecent
preferences.title: Recent Files
preferences.description: Remember the last 20 files opened with this extension, stored locally.
preferences.label: Show recently opened files

scripts.lint: eslint src && prettier --check src tests/search.test.ts tests/tinycast-runtime.mjs tests/package.test.mjs package.json native/upstream.json tsconfig.json eslint.config.js scripts/package.mjs
scripts.package: npm run prepare-native && npm run build && node scripts/package.mjs
